title: SurviveCovid-19++ : A collaborative healthcare game towards educating people about safety measures and vaccination for Covid-19
reasoning: The paper presents and evaluates a game designed to foster empathy for individuals with varied professional backgrounds and to encourage ethical behaviors such as following public health safety measures for the collective good. The user survey explicitly measures 'Attitudinal/Behavioural Change' and empathy, which are core components of morals and ethics.
